{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_length = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Find the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_length.idxmax()

# Print the results
print(mean_flipper_length)
print(f"\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}")"}
